powers.name: Foothold
powers.summary: As a standard action, alter an adjacent stone surface up to 10 feet square for 1 hour. Horizontal stone becomes difficult terrain and gives Medium or smaller creatures a -2 penalty on Acrobatics and CMD; vertical stone grants +10 on Climb checks. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Thin Air
powers.summary: As a free action, create a 5-foot aura for rounds per day equal to druid level. Breathing creatures starting adjacent save or become fatigued; already-fatigued creatures save or take 1 ability damage to every ability score from altitude sickness. The aura expands to 10 feet at level 16.
